units.source_text: 后面的仓库楼上，原封不动地保存着相当多的能乐戏装和贵妇礼服等。

en.t: Upstairs in the storehouse at the back, quite a large number of Noh costumes, court ladies' formal gowns, and other garments had been preserved exactly as they were.

units.source_text: 还有不少南洋各地的印花丝绸。

en.t: There were also quite a few printed silks from various parts of the South Seas.
